messages:
elena: prod alert - sudden spike in 431 header errors starting 02:07 UTC. affected ~1.8% of requests from a few large tenants. canary for route-hash header rolled out at 01:55. can someone triage?

sam: dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/d/headers?panelId=9
errors align with canary start. traces show TS SDK throwing HeaderOverflowError before request even leaves client.

rick: digging in TS SDK logs. we added strict validation around X-Route-Hash length in v4.1.0 (max 4096 bytes) to avoid proxy rejections. looks like console started emitting full route context (service chain + querystring + debug meta) into that header for richer routing. some orgs hit >4k and we throw.

elena: console team conf: yes, we expanded payload to support richer down-the-stack heuristics. didn't realize some legacy clients enforce a limit. suggestion: either compress header (gzip+base64) or move heavy payload to a separate Accept-Route-Meta negotiation endpoint.

rick: hotfix options: 1) make TS SDK tolerant (log.warn + ignore oversized header) 2) auto-truncate to allowed length (risky to change semantics) 3) rollback console canary.

hannah: product POV: priority is customer continuity -> rollback canary for now, patch SDK asap to be tolerant, and design a negotiation scheme for future. :+1:

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/4521 "TS SDK: tolerant header parsing for X-Route-Hash".

sam: ops: requested feature-flag rollback for route-hash payload. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Feature flag "route-hash-expanded" rollback initiated for canary cohort. target: 0% -> 0% (cancelling canary). ETA ~4m.

rick: opened PR with tolerant parsing fallback (try decode+parse, if header.length>4096 => log.warn + treat as missing). CI added unit test for oversized header and e2e with real-sized payload. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/1012

elena: thank you. console will also prototype a compact token (v2) and an Accept-Route-Meta negotiation header so we only send verbose payloads to clients that opt-in. adding ticket: CONSOLE-778.

sam: ops ask: add a dashboard panel for header size histogram and an alert if median header size > 2k across requests for 10m. that will help catch regressions before SDKs break.

hannah: product: agree on the dashboard. about quotas: we discussed whether to bill for header size (network bytes) - hold off for now, monitoring only.

rick: rolled v4.1.1 patch to npm with tolerant behavior, added changelog and migration note: "Clients should not assume presence or parseability of X-Route-Hash; treat it as optional." link: https://npmjs.com/package/redwood-sdk/v/4.1.1

ci-bot: Release published and tagged: v4.1.1.

elena: once SDK patch is live, we'll re-enable a 5% canary with compact token disabled by default. then we can ramp and enable Accept-Route-Meta opt-in for a subsequent release.

sam: ops: created alert "header-size-median-high" and added panel to Route Ops dashboard.

hannah: product: plan approved. ops to monitor for 24h after ramp. set rollback gates at +3% errors or any 5xx spikes.

rick: confirming npm release propagated. re-run canary: enabling to 5%. will watch.

elena: thanks team. follow-ups: CONSOLE-778 (negotiation header), SDK-4521 (tolerant parsing), OPS-1129 (dashboard + alert). keeping thread open for status updates. :rocket:
